rationale: The description identifies a full-service data provider offering data exploration and delivery, while forecasting appears as a use of its data and tools. Because the forecasting mechanism and whether forecasting is implemented by the offering are unresolved, non_ai remains weak and forced.
evidence_spans: full-service data provider; from data exploration to delivery
our data and tools have been used to support strategic planning, aid marketing functions, improve sales and retention outcomes, and forecast future customer behavior.
conflict_response: The labeler's forecasting concern is addressed by the wording 'our data and tools have been used,' which describes customer use rather than an explicitly implemented AI forecaster. That supports retaining non_ai, but the predictive use and unresolved mechanism prevent upgrading the blind weak call to supported.
